propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Domine, qui dixisti: Nisi efficiamini sicut parvuli, non intrabitis in
regnum caelorum: da nobis, quaesumus; ita sanctae Teresiae Virginis in
humilitate et simplicitate cordis vestigia sectari, ut praemia
consequamur aeterna: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre in unitate.

translations.caution: Original study translation; not approved for liturgical use or recitation.
translations.text: Lord, you said, "Unless you become like little children, you will not enter the kingdom of heaven." Grant us, we pray, to follow in the footsteps of Saint Thérèse the virgin in humility and simplicity of heart, so that we may attain eternal rewards, you who live and reign with God the Father in unity.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Sacrificium nostrum tibi, Domine, quaesumus, sanctae Teresiae Virginis
tuae precatio sancta conciliet: ut, in cujus honore solemniter
exhibetur, ejus meritis efficiatur acceptum. Per Dominum nostrum.

translations.caution: Original study translation; not approved for liturgical use or recitation.
translations.text: Lord, we pray, may the holy prayer of Saint Thérèse, your virgin, win your favor for our sacrifice, so that what is solemnly offered in her honor may be made acceptable by her merits. Through our Lord.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Illo nos, Domine, amoris igne caeleste mysterium inflammet: quo sancta
Teresia Virgo tua se tibi pro hominibus caritatis victimam devovit.
Per Dominum nostrum.

translations.caution: Original study translation; not approved for liturgical use or recitation.
translations.text: Lord, may the heavenly mystery inflame us with that fire of love by which Saint Thérèse, your virgin, devoted herself to you for humankind as a sacrificial victim of love. Through our Lord.
